model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for five different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, and ROME. The x-axis represents the Co-occurrence Number, labeled with a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC (%), labeled with a linear scale ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black line with circle markers, starting at around 38% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 44% at 10^3. The FT model is depicted by a blue line with inverted triangle markers, beginning at around 40% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rising to about 49% at 10^3. The IKE model is shown as a red line with triangle markers, starting at roughly 43% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to approximately 50% at 10^3. The MEND model is represented by a brown line with diamond markers, beginning at around 45% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rising to about 57% at 10^3. The ROME model is illustrated by a green line with square markers, starting at approximately 51% at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increasing to around 66% at 10^3. Overall, the plot shows that all models exhibit an upward trend in ACC (%) as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
